text:
Maya R: Tiny ask  looking for 40-60min combos: one short reading + one album tracklist to sip espresso to. Aim: low-key, slightly uncanny, no lyrics preferred. Any staples? :coffee: :crescent_moon:
Samir: If you want uncanny + repetitive: Basinski loop(s) + any Borges microfiction. Basinski pairs with short dense sentences very well. :thinking:
Jon K: Bohren & der Club of Gore for the noir vibe. Pair with Calvino's Invisible Cities (read 3-4 entries). Quiet, a little eerie, great for focus. :film_projector:
Priya: For something warmer: Balmorhea (Rivers Arms) + The Mezzanine by Nicholson Baker. That book's little observations match the hushed instrumentals. :book:
Lydia: Samanta Schweblin short story + Grouper (Dragging a Dead Deer Up a Hill) if you want unsettling but oddly tender. :sparkles:
Alex: If you're open to a visual option: Under the Skin with Mica Levi soundtrack on headphones. Not for sleep but immersive while sipping. :eyes:
Samir: Single-track suggestions to stitch into ~50min playlist: Basinski loop (~12m), Nils Frahm 'Felt' piece (~10m), Balmorhea single (~8m), Helios ambient (~10m). Rotate reading between long tracks. :musical_keyboard:
Maya R: Love this. Anyone want to make a shared playlist file and drop a 45-60min export here? I can test it tomorrow AM with espresso ritual. :clipboard:
Priya: I'll assemble a 50min mix tonight and include timestamps when to read which excerpt (few Calvino entries + a Schweblin). Will post link. :+1:
OpsBot: Heads up  3rd-floor espresso machine currently offline for maintenance. ETA ~20-35m. Alternative: instant and French press in pantry. :wrench: :coffee:
Jon K: Thanks OpsBot. @Maya R if the hard stuff arrives, I'll bring a bag of single-origin beans as backup tomorrow morning. Who's in for a cuppa test? :grin:
Maya R: Count me in. Drop the playlist link here @Priya when ready and I'll try to match reading excerpts to the tracks. Thanks y'all
